event_description: Fires when a user successfully logs in with their username and password
Fires when a user taps the Logout button from the drawer
Fires when a user sends a chat message in a conversation channel
Fires when a user selects a chat channel from the drawer
Fires when a user navigates to a profile screen (clicking author avatar or selecting from drawer)
Fires when a user opens the emoji/attachment selector panel in the chat input
Fires when a user clicks on a message author name or avatar to view their profile
